Name: UnwriteLaw
PhysicalVerb: Briefly suspend a named local physics rule at a marked site; restore the rule automatically.
Telegraph: Ground-outline and sound fade before the duration expires.
Limitation: High strain and limited duration; never delete saved history.
OuterRealmUses: Harmonic support, contradiction thresholds and localized sound silence

Name: Witnesscraft
PhysicalVerb: Tag evidence as directly witnessed, rumored or unconfirmed before a testimony choice.
Telegraph: Three confidence glyphs, never an invisible morality color.
Limitation: Cannot fabricate or force consent from any witness.
OuterRealmUses: Civic records, competing choir accounts and personal memory conflicts

Name: BorrowedLives
PhysicalVerb: Borrow an alternate professional capability temporarily without changing real identity.
Telegraph: Visible borrowed posture and temporary skill ribbon.
Limitation: Cannot impersonate a living NPC or keep borrowed craft indefinitely.
OuterRealmUses: Impossible ancestry masonry and personal origin testimony

Name: LegacyForging
PhysicalVerb: Temper one-time discovered, protected and reconciled deeds into equipment history.
Telegraph: Three distinct inscription marks on a tool.
Limitation: Cannot farm the same deed or rewrite harmed families' provenance.
OuterRealmUses: Quarry supports and tool ownership disputes

Name: LivingRoads
PhysicalVerb: Reveal and open a path that two legitimate communities agreed to share.
Telegraph: Physical road seam visibly connects before the player steps.
Limitation: Temporary unless earned reconciliation stabilizes it.
OuterRealmUses: Garden commons, refugee roads and consent-based passages

Name: TomorrowDebt
PhysicalVerb: Borrow brief strength with a visible due date and later exhaustion.
Telegraph: Clock-facing debt ribbon, warning before collection.
Limitation: Debt cannot be displaced onto innocent people or borrowed endlessly.

Name: UnderstandingBosses
PhysicalVerb: Interpret readable enemy patterns and allow a witnessed nonlethal solution.
Telegraph: Boss threat tells paired with memory fragment, optional mercy prompt.
Limitation: A learned name is not automatic pacification; player must survive or negotiate.

Name: ParadoxConvergence
PhysicalVerb: Hold two versions of a place briefly so both routes and records can be inspected.
Telegraph: Dual outlines with reliable entrance and return.
Limitation: Temporary; strain and cooldown, not a permanent map cheat.
OuterRealmUses: Inverted sky, temporal seam and multiple origins

Name: Oathbinding
PhysicalVerb: Attach a measurable protection benefit to an explicit local promise.
Telegraph: Visible vow link to the protected people and breach warning.
Limitation: Broken oath has recorded consequences; consent is never implied.
OuterRealmUses: Public ferry, warm kiln and refusal of unlawful crown

Name: Cartography
PhysicalVerb: Mark speculative, rumored and personally traversed routes differently.
Telegraph: Solid versus dashed path and witness tags.
Limitation: Does not declare an unverified crossing safe merely because it is mapped.
OuterRealmUses: Sea absence, false roads and impossible origins
